question.stem:
A data analytics company, which uses machine learning to collect and analyze consumer data, is using Redshift cluster as their data warehouse. You are instructed to implement a disaster recovery plan for their systems to ensure business continuity even in the event of an AWS region outage.
Which of the following is the best approach to meet this requirement?
options: Do nothing because Amazon Redshift is a highly available, fully-managed data warehouse which can withstand an outage of an entire AWS region.
Use Automated snapshots of your Redshift Cluster.
Create a scheduled job that will automatically take the snapshot of your Redshift Cluster and store it to an S3 bucket. Restore the snapshot in case of an AWS region outage.
Enable Cross-Region Snapshots Copy in your Amazon Redshift Cluster.
question.explanation: A Redshift cluster runs in one Region (Multi-AZ exists only for RA3 and does not cover a Region outage). For Region-level disaster recovery, enable cross-Region snapshot copy so that automated and manual snapshots are copied automatically to a second Region, where you can restore a new cluster during an outage. Doing nothing leaves no recovery path, automated snapshots stay in the same Region (and are stored in S3 managed by Redshift), and a hand-made scheduled snapshot job to S3 still stays in the source Region and is custom work.

concept: Redshift DR across Regions: enable cross-Region snapshot copy
tests: Knowing that Region-outage protection for a Redshift cluster comes from cross-Region snapshot copy (restore in the other Region), not from the cluster's own availability or same-Region snapshots.
expected: Enable cross-Region snapshot copy (with a retention period; use a KMS grant for encrypted clusters) and restore the cluster from the copied snapshot in the destination Region. Triggers: 'Redshift', 'disaster recovery', 'AWS Region outage'.
why_not: A cluster is a single-Region resource, so it does not survive a Region outage by itself. Automated snapshots stay in the same Region and do not help when the Region is down. A custom scheduled snapshot job to S3 stays in the same Region unless copied, and it duplicates a built-in feature.
